ts-preferences-restore-intro: Text beside the Restore all defaults button of Special:Preferences.
ts-preferences-restore: Button of Special:Preferences that resets every preference, as action=options&reset=1 does.
ts-preferences-restored: Notice on Special:Preferences after Restore all defaults.
ts-preferences-anon: Notice on Special:Preferences for a reader who is not logged in.
ts-preferences-anon-appearance: Text on Special:Preferences for a reader who is not logged in, pointing to the Appearance menu (ADR 0085 §5–6).
ts-preferences-denied: Error on Special:Preferences when the account lacks the editmyoptions right.
ts-wikisettings-title: Title of Special:WikiSettings, a wiki's settings (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-instancesettings-title: Title of Special:InstanceSettings, the instance's settings, served at the farm base (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-read-only: Notice at the top of Special:WikiSettings or Special:InstanceSettings for a viewer who may change none of the settings.
ts-settings-none:
Shown for a setting or preference that has no value.
{{Identical|None}}
ts-settings-on: Shown for a setting whose value is true.
ts-settings-off: Shown for a setting whose value is false.
ts-settings-empty-list: Shown for a setting whose value is an empty list.
ts-settings-unset: Shown for a tenancy switch the instance has not set.
ts-settings-origin-registry:
Origin chip of a setting whose value is the registry default (ADR 0085 §4).
{{Identical|Default}}
ts-settings-origin-instance: Origin chip of a wiki's setting whose value is the instance's default for it (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-origin-instance-own: Origin chip of an instance setting the instance has set (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-origin-tenant: Origin chip of a setting the wiki has set itself (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-origin-locked: Origin chip of a setting the instance has locked (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-origin-capped:
Origin chip of a setting whose value an instance ceiling has capped (ADR 0085 §4).

Parameters:
* $1 - the ceiling
ts-settings-reset:
Button of a setting or preference row that returns it to inheriting its default.
{{Identical|Reset}}
ts-settings-reset-label:
Accessible label of the Reset button of a row.

Parameters:
* $1 - the setting's or preference's label
ts-settings-summary:
Label of the summary field of a section of the settings pages, kept with the change in the log.
{{Identical|Summary}}
ts-settings-save:
Button that saves one section of Special:WikiSettings or Special:InstanceSettings.
{{Identical|Save}}
ts-settings-saved: Notice in a section of the settings pages after it was saved.
ts-settings-unresolved-default: Note on a setting whose instance default is a reference this wiki cannot resolve (ADR 0085 §2.1).
ts-settings-group-tenancy: Heading of the Tenancy section of the settings pages (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-group-defaults: Heading of the section of Special:InstanceSettings that sets the instance's defaults for every wiki (ADR 0085 §4).
ts-settings-tenancy-wiki: Introduction to the read-only Tenancy section of Special:WikiSettings.
ts-settings-tenancy-instance: Introduction to the Tenancy section of Special:InstanceSettings.
ts-settings-tenancy-locked: Subheading of the Tenancy section of Special:WikiSettings listing the settings the instance has locked.
ts-settings-tenancy-none-locked: Shown when the instance has locked no setting.
ts-settings-tenancy-ceilings: Subheading of the Tenancy section of Special:WikiSettings listing the instance's ceilings on settings.
ts-settings-tenancy-no-ceilings: Shown when the instance sets no ceiling.
ts-settings-defaults-intro: Introduction to Defaults for wikis on Special:InstanceSettings under config.template = defaults.
ts-settings-defaults-intro-locks: Introduction to Defaults for wikis on Special:InstanceSettings under config.template = locks.
ts-settings-registry-default:
Under each setting in Defaults for wikis: the default that applies without the instance's.

Parameters:
* $1 - the registry default
ts-settings-no-default: The empty choice of an instance default, and what is shown where there is none.
ts-settings-lock:
Checkbox in Defaults for wikis that locks the setting for every wiki.
{{Identical|Lock}}
ts-settings-inheriting:
Under each setting in Defaults for wikis: how many wikis inherit the default (ADR 0085 §4).

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of wikis
ts-settings-conflict: Error on a settings page when a setting changed since the page was loaded (editconflict).
ts-settings-denied: Error on a settings page when the viewer lacks the right to change a setting.
ts-settings-locked: Error on Special:WikiSettings for a setting the instance has locked (ts-locked).
